t: A spaceflight game where players build rockets and fly them with real physics.
steps: Find the game on Steam, GOG, or Epic.
Ask IT to approve a purchase and an install on one test computer.
Check that the computer can run a 3D game.
Play the tutorials and build a simple rocket.
Check whether an account is needed. The materials do not say.
Plan a short challenge, such as reaching orbit.
Review the game's content before class.
